question: Which stadiums have never hosted a concert?
reference_sql: SELECT s.Name FROM stadium AS s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM concert AS c WHERE c.Stadium_ID = CAST(s.Stadium_ID AS VARCHAR))
candidate_sql:
SELECT s.Name
FROM stadium AS s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM concert AS c
    WHERE TRY_CAST(c.Stadium_ID AS BIGINT) = s.Stadium_ID
);
